Ticket:
Waiting room queue status columns and check-in time display

Hi support, we are trying to get our front desk waiting room queue configured properly, but I am a bit confused by how the check-in timestamps are displaying. When a patient arrives and we mark them as checked in, the column sometimes shows the arrival time and sometimes shows the appointment time, and I cannot figure out which button or setting controls this view. Also, is there a way to add a custom status column for triage? I tried clicking around the settings menu under front desk options, but nothing seemed to change the layout on our main dashboard. Could you walk me through how to customize these columns correctly?
